expr: [Last, [List, [Assign, userHead, [Function, x, x]], [SetAttributes, userHead, Orderless], [Attributes, userHead]]]
caption: define a head of your own, turn Orderless on, then read it back with Attributes
wolfram.note: Wolfram needs no definition before a symbol takes attributes; here the head is defined first, since SetAttributes leaves an undeclared symbol alone.

caption: a declared head is Protected: the call stays unevaluated and says SetAttributes::write
wolfram.note: Wolfram's Protected guards a symbol's definitions, not its attributes (only Locked does), so it sets the attribute and returns Null. Here a declared head's flags are shared engine state, so the call is refused.
Attributes reads compute-engine's operator flags, which cannot say HoldFirst: a lazy head is reported as HoldAll. Wolfram answers {HoldFirst, Protected}; Protected agrees.
